key.name: net-speed-enabled
key.summary: Show internet speed in the top bar

key.name: net-speed-interval
key.summary: Refresh interval in seconds

key.name: net-speed-display
key.summary: What to show: download+upload, download only, upload only, or combined total

key.name: net-speed-position
key.summary: Top bar section

key.name: net-speed-index
key.summary: Position inside the top bar section (0 = first)

key.name: net-speed-use-bits
key.summary: Show bits per second (Mb/s) instead of bytes (MB/s)

key.name: net-speed-hide-idle
key.summary: Hide indicator when there is no traffic

key.name: app-grid-sort-enabled
key.summary: Sort the app grid alphabetically

key.name: app-grid-sort-folders
key.summary: Where folders go: mixed with apps, before apps, or after apps

key.name: app-grid-sort-folder-contents
key.summary: Also sort apps inside folders

key.name: app-grid-two-line-enabled
key.summary: Show app names on up to two lines in the app grid

key.name: caffeine-enabled
key.summary: Add a Caffeine toggle to Quick Settings

key.name: caffeine-show-indicator
key.summary: Show a top bar icon while Caffeine is on

key.name: caffeine-restore
key.summary: Restore Caffeine after login if it was left on

key.name: caffeine-active
key.summary: Internal: whether Caffeine was left on indefinitely

key.name: clipboard-enabled
key.summary: Keep a clipboard history in the top bar

key.name: clipboard-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut to open the clipboard history
key.description: Empty by default: extensions.gnome.org doesn't allow default shortcuts for clipboard access.

key.name: clipboard-history-size
key.summary: Number of entries to keep

key.name: clipboard-paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste into the focused window after picking an entry

key.name: color-picker-enabled
key.summary: Pick a color from the screen with a shortcut

key.name: color-picker-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut to start the color picker

key.name: color-picker-format
key.summary: Copy colors as #rrggbb or rgb(r, g, b)

key.name: hide-activities-enabled
key.summary: Hide the Activities button in the top bar
